raw:
"I remember a foul puddle in a public shower. What really disgusted me was that it was somewhere you’re supposed to get clean. I didn’t know what was in it, and I didn’t want to find out. Just the thought of stepping in it was horrible.

Once I’d noticed it, I couldn’t really put it out of my mind. I kept looking at the floor, wondering where the water had come from and whether it had spread farther than I could see. Water usually seems like something clean, doesn’t it? But that puddle made the whole shower feel dirty to me, not just that one spot."
